response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_remaincount) AS average_unfilled_quantity, SUM(execution_count) AS total_executions FROM (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_remaincount, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions WHERE expirespot BETWEEN '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY ordersmark) AS per_order
